授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
This course explores the intersection of data science and environmental challenges in Asia. It is divided into two distinct parts:
Part 1: Foundations of programming in Python and an introduction to machine learning.
Part 2: Guest lectures on the Science of Production Environments, focusing on regional issues in Asia.
